text_block_list.text:
During training, North Flight suffered an 
injury, so we hurried to the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Gh...
choice_data_list:
Don't move! I'll get painkillers from the 
doctor right away—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Please calm down. Times like these are 
when it's most important to keep your 
composure, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That's what I was taught in the past, too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Because I pushed too hard, I ended up 
unable to do anything. I panicked, and 
that only made things worse...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"So let us stay calm for now. Place your 
hand gently on your chest before you act. 
I am sure everything will be fine."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —And besides...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"In my experience, with mild symptoms like 
this, you should be fine in about two 
days."
choice_data_list: No, let's play it safe and rest some more.
Understood... If that's what you say.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"In my experience, with mild symptoms like 
this, you should be fine in about two 
days."
choice_data_list: No, let's play it safe and rest some more.
Understood... If that's what you say.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, understood. ...I'll make sure to 
get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"What's important right now is taking care 
of your body. It seems I was the one who 
was rushing things."

And so, I decided to let North Flight rest 
for a little while.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's why I want you to go ahead and 
get everything ready for training, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Two days from now, surely—
—And two days later.
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Hello? ...I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I sounded so full of confidence the other 
day, but it seems I'm still not quite back 
in form.

Afterward, I soothed North Flight over the 
phone and had her get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Fufu. This is certainly a 
menu tailored just right for them.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! I'm gonna go run right 
away♪

And true to her word, North Flight tackled 
her training with full energy.
